lines: In a noun clause: no question word order.

items.title: be goes to the end
lines: Question: be + subject. Noun clause: subject + be.

talk.title: I wonder…
talk.task: Claude asks you questions. If you don't know, say “I don't know where…” or “I wonder why…”
talk.claudePrompt: You are my English speaking partner. Ask me one question at a time that I probably can't answer: Where does the president live? What time does the nearest library close? How far is it to the airport from here? Who won the Nobel Peace Prize last year? How long does it take the moon to go around the earth? I answer with a noun clause: I don't know where ... / I wonder how far ... Check my word order: question word + subject + verb, no do/does/did.

talk.title: Can you tell me if…?

talk.title: I'm glad that…

talk.claudePrompt: You are my English speaking partner. Ask me one question at a time: What is something in your life that you're glad about? What disappointed you in the past?
